name: load_icon_record_fields
description: Reads two integer fields into the record, then conditionally reads a counted block of pointers and a further value, undoing partial work on failure. Returns 1 on success and 0 otherwise.

name: read_icon_pointer_table
description: Reads values into a pointer table one by one while a remaining-length counter stays above a threshold, then reads one trailing value. Returns 1 when every read succeeds and 0 on any failure.

name: return_zero_after_call
description: Calls one library routine and then returns zero regardless of its result.

name: return_without_work
description: Does nothing and returns immediately, serving as an empty placeholder entry.

name: write_icon_record_to_stream
description: Allocates a temporary buffer, writes the record's header fields and its optional data blocks in order as size-prefixed chunks, then frees the buffer and restores a saved field. Returns the success status of the write.

name: write_info_icon_contents
description: Writes an icon record's fields and optional blocks to a stream using the library's write routine, referencing the .info text. Returns 1 on complete success and 0 if any write fails.

name: write_icon_optional_blocks
description: Writes the record's optional blocks, a pointer table and a trailing block, each preceded by its length, and returns 1 only if every write succeeds.

name: write_table_length_and_entries
description: Counts the entries of a null-terminated pointer table, writes that total length, then writes each entry with its length prefix followed by a trailing block when present.

name: write_icon_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of pointers, writing each entry with a length prefix and its contents through the write routine, then writes a trailing block if present.

name: free_node_chain_entries
description: Walks a linked list from a fixed offset in the node, releasing each node through a library call until it reaches the end or an empty link, then releases the final node.

name: iterate_linked_list_nodes
description: Walks a linked list by following the link stored at a fixed offset in each node, calling a library routine on each node until the list ends or a stop value appears, then processes the final node.

name: forward_call_at_offset
description: Calls the same routine again with the first argument unchanged and the second advanced by a fixed 140-byte offset.

name: allocate_zeroed_record_block
description: Allocates a 168-byte zero-filled record, sets up a field at a fixed offset with library calls, and returns the record; on setup failure it frees the block and returns null.

name: call_library_and_return
description: Calls one library routine with no arguments and returns without producing a value.

name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero with no other work, serving as a constant-result stub.

name: append_pair_with_refill
description: Decrements an entry counter, refilling the buffer through a library routine when it runs out, then stores two values into the next pair slot. Returns 1 on success and 0 if the refill fails.

name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter and stores two register values into the next pair slot of the table referenced by the buffer, then returns 1.

name: allocate_zeroed_control_block
description: Allocates a 94-byte zero-filled block, initializes a region at a fixed offset with two library calls, and returns the block; on failure it releases the block and returns null.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work and acts as an empty stub.

name: call_then_return_zero
description: Calls one library routine and then returns zero.

name: chain_next_record_call
description: Calls the same routine for the next record block by adding a fixed 78-byte offset to the second argument, passing the first argument unchanged.

name: find_value_after_equals
description: Searches a null-terminated list of entries, testing each against a key through a library routine, and returns a pointer to the text after the equals sign of the matching entry, or null when none match.

name: scan_list_for_equals_sign
description: Scans a null-terminated list of strings for an entry whose text contains an equals sign at the matched position, returning a pointer to the value after it, or null when the list ends.

name: search_list_for_key_value
description: Iterates a null-terminated list of pointers, calling a library routine for each entry, and returns the text following an equals sign when the test succeeds, or null when the list ends.

name: find_matching_delimited_segment
description: Walks the separator-delimited segments of a string, looking for one whose length matches a reference length and that a library routine confirms as equal to the given text. Returns 1 when found and 0 otherwise.

name: scan_delimited_segments_for_match
description: Steps through the separator-delimited segments of a string and checks each segment's length against a reference value, confirming matches through a library routine. Returns 1 when a confirmed match is found and 0 when the string ends first.

name: search_segments_for_reference_length
description: Repeatedly locates the next separator in a string, measures each segment, and returns 1 when a segment of the reference length is confirmed by a library routine, or 0 when no segment qualifies.

name: check_segment_length_match
description: Compares the length of each separator-delimited segment with a reference length and confirms candidate segments with a library call. Returns 1 for a confirmed segment and 0 if none is confirmed.

name: test_segment_list_for_match
description: Tests separator-delimited segments in sequence, treating a segment as matching when its length equals the reference and a library routine reports equality. Returns 1 on the first match and 0 if the list ends without one.

name: parse_copy_label_count
description: Reads an optional copy label from the start of a text record, followed by a decimal count when present, defaulting the count to one, then stores the count and the remaining text in the output record. Returns the output record.

name: parse_decimal_count_after_label
description: Checks for a three-character label at a fixed position in a text record, then reads the decimal number that follows and finishes with two library cleanup calls. Returns nothing.

name: parse_decimal_digits_then_check
description: Reads consecutive decimal digits from the text, accumulating their value, then tests the following four characters with a library routine when the count is non-zero, and finishes with two cleanup calls.

name: parse_count_before_of_text
description: Accumulates the decimal digits of a count in the text, then checks the following ' of ' wording through a library routine when the count is non-zero, and ends with two cleanup calls.

name: convert_char_to_digit
description: Maps a character code to its decimal value from zero to nine, or returns minus one when the character is not a decimal digit.

name: return_negative_one
description: Returns minus one as a fixed failure value and does nothing else.

name: call_library_function_198
description: Calls a library function through the library base held in a global variable, at a fixed negative offset, and returns nothing.

name: call_library_function_210
description: Calls a library function through the library base held in a global variable, at a fixed negative offset, and returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_register_with_cleanup
description: Allocates a value from the first pair of arguments, passes it with the remaining arguments to a second routine, and releases the value with a cleanup call if that second step fails, returning zero in that case.

name: allocate_initialized_record
description: Allocates a 96-byte zero-filled block, stores ten in its field at a fixed offset and in the caller's word, and calls a library routine on the block, returning whether allocation succeeded.

name: return_zero_placeholder
description: Returns zero and does nothing else.

name: verify_result_matches_argument
description: Calls a library routine with three arguments and returns its result only when it equals the fourth argument, otherwise returns zero.

name: confirm_library_result_match
description: Calls another library routine with three arguments and returns the result only when it equals the fourth argument, otherwise returns zero.

name: return_empty_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: divide_32_bit_unsigned
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by a divisor, using a shift-and-subtract loop when the divisor is large and direct 16-bit division otherwise, and returns the quotient and remainder.

name: perform_division_step_loop
description: Runs sixteen shift-and-subtract iterations that shift a 32-bit value and subtract the divisor from its high half whenever it fits, leaving the quotient and remainder in registers.

name: multiply_32_bit_values
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product.

name: invoke_formatting_library_entry
description: Calls the library's raw formatting routine through a function pointer kept at a fixed offset in the global library base, with no arguments and no return value.

name: store_byte_to_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register through the address register, storing one byte at the target pointer.

name: measure_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string by decrementing an accumulator for each character and returns the complemented result as the length.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Walks a null-terminated string and returns a pointer to the first occurrence of the given character, or null when it is absent.

name: return_zero_constant
description: Returns zero with no other work.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from the source string into the destination, including the terminating zero byte.

name: append_string_to_destination
description: Advances to the end of the destination string, then copies the source string there including its terminating zero byte.

name: compare_strings_up_to_limit
description: Compares two strings character by character up to a given count, returning 1 when a difference is found and 0 when they match within the limit or the count runs out.

name: return_one_constant
description: Returns one with no other work.

name: terminate_bounded_string_scan
description: Walks a string up to a given count, and when the terminating zero byte is reached makes a library call; otherwise it returns without the call.

name: forward_to_library_routine
description: Calls a library routine with no arguments and returns without a value.

name: copy_string_with_zero_padding
description: Copies at most a fixed number of bytes from source to destination, stopping after the terminating zero, then fills any remaining space up to the limit with zero bytes.

name: return_empty_stub_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: initialize_empty_list_header
description: Sets up an empty linked list header, pointing its first link at the following slot, clearing the next link, and pointing the last link back at the header itself.

name: process_record_header_and_payload
description: Transfers a 20-byte header through a library routine, then transfers the payload whose address is stored in the record, returning 1 when there is nothing to transfer and 0 when the header transfer fails.

name: transfer_record_chain_entries
description: Walks a linked chain of records, transferring each record's 16-byte header and then its data block sized by a count stored in the header, returning 1 when the chain completes and 0 on any failure.

name: walk_record_chain_pairs
description: Walks a linked chain, calling two library routines on each record and following its next link at a fixed offset, returning 1 when the chain ends and 0 when a routine fails.

name: return_zero_flag
description: Returns zero with no other work.

name: allocate_configured_record
description: Allocates a 20-byte zero-filled record when the flag argument is set, fills its field with a value from a library call, and returns the record; it returns zero when the flag is clear and minus one on failure.

name: return_failure_minus_one
description: Returns minus one as a failure value with no other work.

name: allocate_record_chain
description: Allocates a chain of 16-byte records, linking each to the previous one and filling each with data read through library calls, and returns the head of the chain or minus one when any step fails.

name: read_record_chain_into_list
description: Reads a chain of 16-byte records through a library call, storing each record's data block pointer and linking the records together, and returns the head record or minus one on a read failure.

name: read_record_chain_links
description: Reads a sequence of records, linking each to the next and storing their data blocks, and returns the first record when the sequence ends or minus one when a read fails.

name: return_error_code_minus_one
description: Returns minus one with no other work, serving as an error code stub.

name: create_and_register_library
description: Creates a library structure through a library call, and if that succeeds stores the global base and a parameter in it and registers it with the system library list. Returns minus one on success and zero when creation fails.

name: increment_counter_clear_flag
description: Increments a 16-bit counter in the structure and clears one flag bit in its status byte.

name: decrement_counter_and_signal
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure, and when it reaches zero while a flag bit is set, makes a library call and returns its result; otherwise returns zero.

name: unlink_or_mark_pending_node
description: If a counter in the node is zero, unlinks the node from its list and makes a library call, returning that call's value; otherwise it sets a pending flag on the node and returns zero.

name: unlink_and_release_node
description: Unlinks a node from its doubly linked list, makes a library call on it, and returns the value stored in the node.

name: parse_padded_text_field
description: Fills a local line buffer with spaces, then copies characters from the input text into it, calling library routines per field until a hash character ends the input, and returns the last status value.

name: return_low_word_register
description: Returns the low 16 bits of the data register as the result.

name: terminate_string_and_return_status
description: Makes a library call, writes a zero byte just before the address register, and returns the 16-bit result value.

name: scan_delimited_text_fields
description: Scans input text for space-separated fields with a hash character as an end marker, calling a library routine for each field and returning a 16-bit status value when the scan finishes or fails.

name: scan_text_fields_with_markers
description: Walks input text field by field, treating spaces and hash characters as markers, calls a library routine for each field, and returns a 16-bit status value when the text ends.

name: scan_escaped_text_segments
description: Scans text for backslash escapes and backquote delimiters, copying segments and calling library routines for each, and returns once the final delimiter is reached.

name: scan_escaped_text_loop
description: Reads text character by character, treating backslash and backquote as markers, and calls library routines when a marker closes a segment, returning when the closing marker of the final segment is found.

name: return_no_op_stub
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: match_bracketed_text_prefix
description: Skips ahead to an opening bracket in the text, then compares the following characters against a reference string until a closing bracket, returning when the comparison ends.

name: match_backward_character_class
description: Walks characters backwards from the end of a buffer while they belong to a character-class table, comparing each with the pattern, and returns when a non-matching character or the buffer start is reached.

name: return_without_effect
description: Contains only a return instruction and changes nothing.

name: match_backward_pattern_segment
description: Walks a buffer backwards using a character-class table, returning when the position reaches the start or a character fails to match the pattern.

name: scan_forward_to_equals
description: Reads characters forward from the start of the text, passing over characters in the class table and comparing the rest with the reference text, and returns at an equals sign or when a mismatch occurs.

name: match_text_until_equals
description: Compares input characters against a reference string forward until an equals sign appears, skipping characters flagged in the class table, and returns when they differ.

name: copy_escaped_token_text
description: Copies a token from the text up to a backslash or backquote marker into the output buffer, adjusting the remaining length, and returns the updated position pair.

name: copy_token_and_update_flag
description: Copies a run of characters into the output buffer, sets a flag when the last copied character belongs to a marker class, and returns the updated length pair.

name: copy_fixed_length_token
description: Copies a fixed number of bytes into the output buffer, then sets a flag bit under a condition and clears it again when the following character is a backquote.

name: terminate_token_at_class_boundary
description: Walks backwards from the current position while characters stay in a class, then writes a zero byte at the boundary to terminate the token.

name: dispatch_special_character_handler
description: Looks up the input character in a table of eleven symbol characters and calls the handler at the matching position in a jump table.

name: stub_return_nothing
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: no_op_return_routine
description: Contains only a return instruction and changes nothing.

name: call_one_routine_then_return
description: Calls a single routine with no arguments and returns.

name: poll_until_status_clear
description: Repeatedly calls a routine while bit 5 of a status register remains set, then returns.

name: forward_single_call
description: Makes one routine call with no arguments and returns its outcome without further work.

name: examine_status_character_code
description: Calls a routine when a status bit is set and examines the returned character against two code letters, but takes no further action.

name: return_immediately_stub
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: match_keyword_letters_sequence
description: Matches a short keyword spelled by successive input characters against expected letters, using a flag bit to choose the valid spellings, and returns once the keyword is recognised or rejected.

name: match_negated_keyword_sequence
description: Matches the letters N and G from successive input characters, requiring a trailing S when a flag bit is set, and returns when the sequence ends.

name: return_empty_placeholder
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: pass_control_to_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: invoke_routine_and_return
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: invoke_single_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: invoke_second_routine
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: repeat_call_while_flag_set
description: Calls a routine repeatedly, checking after each call whether bit 5 of a status register is still set, and returns when it clears.

name: invoke_single_routine_again
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: poll_until_second_flag_clear
description: Repeatedly calls a routine while bit 1 of a status register remains set, then returns.

name: check_status_bit_after_call
description: Calls a routine and then tests bit 7 of a status word, taking no further action in either case.

name: return_no_op_placeholder
description: Contains only a return instruction, so it does no work.

name: normalize_text_into_buffer
description: Copies input characters into a fixed-width text buffer, mapping control characters, the closing bracket and lowercase letters to buffer-safe forms, stopping at a hash pair or after 100 characters, and returning minus three when the limit is exceeded.

name: blank_previous_character
description: Writes a space character two bytes before the current buffer position.

name: insert_phoneme_marker_on_match
description: Scans phonetic text for a match in a table of fourteen entries and, on a match, shifts the buffer one place and inserts a marker character, then stores the new end position.

name: shift_and_insert_marker
description: Shifts the buffer contents one place forward from the current end, inserts a marker character at the insertion point, and stores the new end position.

name: stub_unimplemented_instruction
description: The decompiler could not translate its instructions, so the routine has no recovered behaviour beyond a stop marker.

name: store_registers_into_globals
description: Stores two incoming register values into global variables and into a field of the structure given as the first argument.

name: wrap_single_routine_call
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: forward_no_arg_call
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: chain_no_arg_call
description: Calls one routine with no arguments and returns, performing no other work.

name: return_nothing_stub
description: Contains only a return instruction and changes nothing.

name: pass_through_single_call
description: Makes a single routine call and returns, performing no other work.

name: clear_bit_and_count_use
description: Clears bit 3 of a status byte in the structure, increments its 16-bit counter, and returns the structure pointer.

name: release_region_when_unused
description: When a counter in the structure is zero, releases a memory region derived from two of its size fields through library calls and returns the stored result; otherwise it sets bit 3 of a status byte and returns zero.

name: release_structure_region
description: Calls a library routine on the structure, then on a region derived from two of its size fields, then makes another library call, and returns the stored result.

name: decrement_counter_and_release
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure, and when it reaches zero while a status bit is set, calls a routine on the structure and returns its result; otherwise returns zero.

name: return_zero_result_stub
description: Returns zero with no other work.

name: release_global_resources
description: Releases several global resource pointers and an argument pointer by calling a routine on each non-null entry, with a recursive variant for a second argument, and returns nothing.

name: allocate_and_link_workspace
description: Allocates a 944-byte cleared workspace, stores pointers to its internal sub-blocks in global slots, copies default values into several of them, links the lists together, and returns one on success or zero when allocation fails.

name: initialize_workspace_pointers
description: Points the global slots at fixed offsets within an existing workspace, copies default values into its sub-blocks, links its lists together, and returns one.

name: open_system_libraries_or_fail
description: Opens three system libraries including dos.library through library calls, storing each base in a global slot; if any open fails it reports a status code through a cleanup routine and returns zero, otherwise one.

name: open_three_libraries_via_pointer
description: Opens three libraries through a function pointer, storing each base in a global slot, and reports a status code through a second pointer when one fails; returns one on success and zero on failure.

name: open_intuition_and_second_library
description: Opens the intuition library and a second library through a function pointer, storing their bases, and reports a failure status through a second pointer; returns one when both open.

name: open_graphics_library
description: Opens the graphics library through a function pointer and stores its base in a global slot; on failure it reports status five through a second pointer and returns false.

name: return_success_one
description: Returns one as a success status with no other work.

name: get_structure_field_value
description: Returns a cached value from the structure when one is set; otherwise reads a field from a structure chosen by a type code or from its parent, and returns zero when no structure is present.

name: get_structure_value_via_pointer
description: Reads a value from the structure referenced by a pointer argument, returning a cached field when set, otherwise a field from the structure's linked entry, or zero when the link is missing.

name: read_cached_or_linked_value
description: Returns the cached value from the structure if it is set, otherwise a value from its linked entry, or zero when no link exists.

name: read_type_based_value
description: Returns a value from a structure selected by a type code, either the structure itself or its linked entry, or zero when the link is missing.

name: read_linked_entry_value
description: Returns a value stored in a linked entry, or zero when the entry pointer is missing.

name: resolve_disk_info_entry
description: Creates an entry record, copies either the disk information name or a stored name into a 116-byte buffer, looks up the matching entry, and returns its value; for one type it falls back to a stored value and sets a flag.

name: lookup_name_with_fallback_flag
description: Copies a stored name into a local buffer, looks it up through a library call, and returns the result, or a fallback value with a flag set when the lookup fails for a particular type.

name: allocate_paired_buffers
description: Allocates a 36-byte zero-filled block and a 260-byte zero-filled block, copies data into the first, stores a computed size, allocates a region of that size, and returns one on success or zero when any allocation fails.

name: fill_buffer_record_from_pointers
description: Stores a new block pointer, copies a name into the buffer region, computes a size from the stored data, allocates a region of that size, and returns one on success.

name: populate_record_fields
description: Copies a name into a record region, derives a size from stored data, allocates a region of that size, and fills two record fields, returning one on success and zero otherwise.

name: populate_record_fields_directly
description: Copies a name into a record region, derives a size from stored data, allocates a region of that size, and fills two record fields, returning one on success and zero otherwise.

name: populate_record_fields_unchecked
description: Copies a name into a record region, derives a size, allocates a region, records its address, and returns whether the allocation succeeded.

name: store_record_fields_tail
description: Copies a name into a record region and stores two dword fields taken from the source structures, returning one.

name: open_display_resources
description: Clears global resource slots, allocates a 246-byte cleared block, opens the required libraries and resources through library calls, and attaches them; on failure it reports one of several numbered error codes.

name: setup_display_resources_via_pointer
description: Allocates a 246-byte cleared block, acquires dependent resources, links them into the display structure, and reports numbered failure codes through a function pointer.

name: attach_display_resources_partial
description: Allocates a 246-byte cleared block and links its dependent resources into the display structure, reporting numbered failure codes through a function pointer when a step fails.

name: attach_resource_to_display
description: Acquires a resource through a library call, stores it in a global slot, links it into the given structure, and reports an error status through a function pointer on failure.

name: finalize_resource_attachment
description: Obtains a resource, links it into the structure, performs four cleanup calls, and reports the completion status through a function pointer.

name: release_partial_resource_setup
description: Links an acquired resource into the structure, performs four cleanup calls, and reports a status code through a function pointer; the failure path reports code one.

name: report_resource_setup_status
description: Checks the outcome of a setup step and reports success or failure through a function pointer, running cleanup calls first when the step succeeds.

name: report_setup_status_and_cleanup
description: Runs a cleanup call when a flag is clear and an argument is set, performs four cleanup calls, and reports a success status through a function pointer.

name: call_library_function_132
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 132 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_138
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 138 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_198
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 198 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_210
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 210 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_246
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 246 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_294
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 294 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_372
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 372 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_378
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 378 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_414
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 414 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_552
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 552 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_42
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 42 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_96
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 96 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_228
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 228 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_366
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 366 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_462
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 462 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_72
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 72 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_78
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 78 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_234
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 234 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_270
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 270 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: call_library_function_354
description: Calls the library function at a fixed negative offset of 354 bytes from the library base kept in a global slot, passing no arguments and returning nothing.

name: open_info_dialog_from_table
description: Builds a parameter table of sizes and flags on the stack, including the Info release 1.3 text, opens an element through a library call, and makes a second library call on it with the minus-one value when it opens.

name: dispatch_info_event_code
description: Dispatches on a 16-bit event code read from a nested structure, calling a routine with the associated argument, and returns fixed zero or one results for codes that end processing.

name: return_true_stub
description: Returns one with no other work.

name: toggle_status_bit_for_code
description: Maps a 16-bit code to one of seven bit values, XORs that bit into the status word stored in the global block, and calls a routine on the associated structure.

name: store_status_and_notify
description: Stores a register value into the status word in the global block and calls a routine on a field of the given structure.

name: build_info_file_path
description: Formats a directory and file name into a path buffer with the .info suffix, checks related entries through library calls, and returns whether the operation succeeded.

name: validate_disk_icon_flags
description: Formats a name from disk text and checks it through library routines, clearing the result when a check fails or the status bits remain set, and returns that result.

name: check_icon_name_and_flags
description: Formats a name with the .info suffix, checks the entry's type and name through library routines, and clears the result when a check or the status bit test fails.

name: verify_four_library_steps
description: Runs four library calls with a minus-one argument and returns one only when none of them fails; on success it makes one further call on the parameter.

name: verify_three_library_steps
description: Runs three library calls through a function pointer with a minus-one argument and returns one only when none of them fails, calling a routine on success.

name: verify_two_library_steps
description: Runs two library calls through a function pointer with a minus-one argument and returns one only when neither fails, calling a routine on success.

name: verify_single_library_step
description: Makes one call through a function pointer and returns whether it succeeded, calling a routine on success.

name: return_success_after_call
description: Calls one routine and returns one.

name: build_file_panel_gadgets
description: Adds a fixed set of entries at pixel rectangles to the file panel, including the column labels NAME, STATUS and TYPE, by calling a routine for each entry.

name: build_secondary_panel_gadgets
description: Adds seven fixed-position entries with pixel rectangles to the secondary panel by calling a routine for each.

name: build_compact_panel_gadgets
description: Adds seven fixed-position entries with pixel rectangles to a compact panel by calling a routine for each.

name: build_toolbar_gadgets
description: Adds nine fixed-position entries with pixel rectangles to the toolbar by calling a routine for each, with some entries flagged as optional.

name: build_dialog_gadgets
description: Adds nine fixed-position entries with pixel rectangles to the dialog by calling a routine for each.

name: draw_panel_frame_for_mode
description: Chooses a position value from the display mode, draws a frame at fixed coordinates when the list is empty or its entries otherwise, then redraws an optional element when the flag is set.

name: redraw_list_contents_if_flagged
description: Redraws the list's entries when it is empty or the item-count check holds, otherwise draws the items, and repaints a second element when a flag is set.

name: redraw_list_element_optional
description: Redraws a list element through a library call and repaints an optional second element when the flag argument is set.

name: allocate_list_entry_nodes
description: Allocates a list header, then for each entry of a null-terminated table allocates a node and a 128-byte cleared data block, linking them together; returns the header on success or zero when the header allocation fails.
